name: Hallowed Scroll
summary: In Deathknell, the Hallowed Scroll calls newly awakened Forsaken priests to the ruined chapel. Sealed by Dark Cleric Duesten, it begins their training in faith, willpower, and shadow.

sections.title: A Summons to the Faithless
sections.body: Newly risen Forsaken priests feel their bond with the world change violently. As Deathknell is reclaimed amid ongoing chaos, the Hallowed Scroll sends them to seek guidance in the settlement’s ruined chapel. Dark Cleric Duesten’s seal marks the parchment. It introduces the new priests to formal instruction and directs them to report for it, beginning their study of the practical beliefs that shape Forsaken priesthood.

sections.title: The Path of Self-Reliance
sections.body: Dark Cleric Duesten tells priests who answer the summons to leave old teachings behind. The Holy Light, ancestral spirits, and demonic pacts cannot be their crutches. Instead, the scroll begins a discipline grounded in each priest’s own will. Its teachings call on them to survive and rule through conviction, making faith a means of self-command and mastery.

faq.answer: The Hallowed Scroll is a written summons for newly risen Forsaken priests in Deathknell. It directs them to report to Dark Cleric Duesten in the local chapel for formal training.
Dark Cleric Duesten’s personal seal marks the Hallowed Scroll. He trains priests in Deathknell’s abandoned church.

faq.q: What does Dark Cleric Duesten teach when you bring him the scroll?
faq.answer: Dark Cleric Duesten teaches undead priests to leave behind reliance on the Holy Light, ancestral spirits, and otherworldly powers. He says the Forsaken survived through personal willpower and urges young priests to build faith in themselves so they can guide and dominate others.

angles.text: As a Forsaken priest, this parchment marks your break from traditional human faith. It points you toward conviction of your own and the shadowy arts of the Cult of the Forgotten Shadow.
As an undead traveler, you receive this summons as Deathknell urgently gathers and trains the newly awakened, bringing them into Sylvanas’s forces.
